change.summary: Added checkbox-specific painted geometry (10 px indicator, 3 px spacing), separated from scrollbar-arrow and radio dimensions. The recipe uses KDE semantic color roles and keeps the user's model unchanged.
change.tests: 17 focused tests passed for push, toggle, check, radio, combo and spin; py_compile and scoped git diff --check passed. The native public-preview launcher did not start its private Xvfb within 10 seconds, so no public-scene result is claimed.

results.captures: 44 native captures: 11 states per palette; click/release worked and disabled input was blocked in all four palettes.
results.pixel_check: 44/44 state checks passed, 0 differences. Normal and selected GTK2 indicator relief masks each match the local XmToggleButton mask after role-color normalization. The GTK indicator starts 1 px left and its text starts 2 px right versus this local sample.
results.generation_integration: GTK2 generation path translated the check control in four palettes; all 36 generated indicator assets matched the native foundation, with current palette provenance.

limits: The Motif measurement is from the local Theme Lab sample, not the SR10.4 VM; no historical default metric or visual approval is inferred.
The pixel masks match, but local GTK2 and Motif natural widget dimensions and indicator/text offsets still differ.
The GTK2 indicator settings are code-level recipe defaults; dedicated GUI spins for these two check-specific metrics are not exposed yet.
The public preview launch timed out before opening because its private Xvfb did not become ready.
GTK2 is incomplete; no GTK2 theme or XChat/session process was changed.
next: Continue with the GTK2 radio indicator as a separate family. Apply GTK2 to the user's session and XChat only after all GTK2 control families are complete.
